items.title: Charles "Creole Charlie" Levy Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: Now down here in this little minor part, here's Bolden, Morton, Bunk, Bechet, Nunez, Ori and Joe, Joe Oliver, Bacquet, Freddie, Freddie Kepp as we know... They gave us New Orleans jazz

ctx.x: I want you to hear this lyric.

This is In the Good Old Days in New Orleans. In the good old days in New Orleans, arsher loaves and fried shrimps were a dive. Rice cooked just right with ham and red beans with a quart a top of claret wine. In the good old days in New Orleans, nickel shows were where we took our queens. Dixieland jazz music in the cabaret that was living in the good old days. Now down here in this little minor part, here's Bolden, Morton, Bunk, Bechet, Nunez, Ori and Joe, Joe Oliver, Bacquet, Freddie, Freddie Kepp as we know,…
